name: Crisil Ltd
title: Crisil Ltd - 500092 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Crisil Q1 FY26 revenue jumped 30.1% and PAT 45.9%, but management flagged FX gains and a USD4.5m timing pull-forward in RAS, so underlying growth is weaker than headline and no numeric guidance was given.

triggers.label: Q1 revenue +30.1% includes timing effect
triggers.quote: the accelerated closure of renewals in one of our global businesses has led to incremental revenues of approximately USD4.5 million in quarter 1 FY26
triggers.highlight: incremental revenues of approximately USD4.5 million

triggers.label: Bond issuance down 12% in Q1 CY26
triggers.quote: In Q1 2026, the bond issuances declined by 12% on Y -o-Y basis.

triggers.label: Ratings pricing kept vague
triggers.quote: Pricing is a very sensitive matter. Of course, deal by deal, we will not have a visibility of what's happening on pricing
triggers.highlight: Pricing is a very sensitive matter

guidance.quote: We expect the bank credit to grow at around 13% in fiscal 2027

red_flags.label: Q1 growth flattered by timing and FX
red_flags.quote: aided by both underlying business growth as well as certain timing effects

red_flags.label: Bond issuance softness and substitution to bank loans
red_flags.quote: substitution of corporate bonds with bank loans by many large corporates

red_flags.label: Management declines forward guidance
red_flags.quote: we don't make any forward-looking statements

evasions.quote: Pricing is a very sensitive matter. Of course, deal by deal, we will not have a visibility of what's happening on pricing

evasions.topic: Forward guidance on ratings and GAC growth
evasions.quote: no comment on any forward-looking statement
Sorry, we don't comment on order books of individual businesses.
